description: This file defines the API for interacting with a database in a software project, including functions for initialization, parameter value access, transaction management, and factory reset procedures. It also contains macros and external variable declarations related to the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_Init
methods.description: Initializes the database with the specified database file.

methods.name: DATABASE_Start
methods.description: Starts the database operations after initialization.

methods.name: DATABASE_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_PerformFactoryReset_ControllerInitiated
methods.description: Performs a factory reset triggered by the controller.

methods.name: DATABASE_GetParameterValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter specified by path and other identifiers.

methods.name: DATABASE_SetParameterValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a specified parameter.

methods.name: DATABASE_DeleteParameter
methods.description: Deletes a parameter from the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the database for debugging.

methods.name: DATABASE_ReadDataModelInstanceNumbers
methods.description: Reads instance numbers from the data model, optionally removing unknown parameters.

methods.name: DATABASE_GetMigratedHash
methods.description: Retrieves the migrated hash value for a given hash.
